scenarios.name: SP1-S2-01 Call 1 produces a valid RequirementSet

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid RequirementSet JSON with requirements REQ-1 and REQ-2
Stage 2 Call 1 requirements derivation is run
a RequirementSet model is produced
each requirement has a req_id, description, classification, and source_constraint

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-02 requirements are classified as control or constraint

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RequirementSet with REQ-1 classified as control and REQ-2 classified as constraint
Stage 2 Call 1 requirements derivation is run
REQ-1 has classification control
REQ-2 has classification constraint

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-03 requirement with invalid classification fails

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RequirementSet with REQ-1 classified as <bad_class>
Stage 2 Call 1 requirements derivation is run
validation fails with error containing classification

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-04 each requirement references a source constraint

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RequirementSet where REQ-1 references SC-1 and REQ-2 references SC-2
Stage 2 Call 1 requirements derivation is run
REQ-1 has source_constraint SC-1
REQ-2 has source_constraint SC-2

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-05 Call 1 is logged with stage stage_2 and step call_1_requirements

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid RequirementSet JSON
a run directory for call logging
Stage 2 Call 1 requirements derivation is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is call_1_requirements

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-06 Call 2a produces a valid ResponsibilitySet

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid ResponsibilitySet JSON with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2
Stage 2 Call 2a responsibilities derivation is run
a ResponsibilitySet model is produced
each responsibility has at least one responsibility constraint and one process model part

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-07 Call 2a does not emit control elements

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid ResponsibilitySet JSON with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2
Stage 2 Call 2a responsibilities derivation is run
the `ResponsibilitySet` model does not declare `<control_element_field>`

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-08 Call 2b produces a valid ControlElementSet

steps.text: a valid ResponsibilitySet from Call 2a
an LLM that returns a valid ControlElementSet JSON with controlled process CP-1
Stage 2 Call 2b control elements derivation is run
a ControlElementSet model is produced
the ControlElementSet contains controlled process CP-1

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-09 each Stage 2 call is logged with its own step name

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all four Stage 2 calls
a run directory for call logging
Stage 2 control structure derivation is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
a call log entry exists with step <step_name>

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-10 assembly of Call 2a and Call 2b produces a valid ControlStructure

steps.text: a valid ResponsibilitySet from Call 2a
an LLM that returns a valid ControlElementSet JSON with controlled process CP-1
Stage 2 control structure derivation is run
a ControlStructure model is produced
the control structure passes foundation validation

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-11 coordination links are identified in Call 3

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for Stage 2 calls 1, 2a, and 2b
an LLM that returns a CoordinationAnalysis with coordination link CL-1 from RESP-1 to RESP-2 sharing PM-1-1
Stage 2 control structure derivation is run
the ControlStructure contains coordination link CL-1
CL-1 has source RESP-1 and target RESP-2

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-12 the retired three-call step names are absent

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all four Stage 2 calls
Stage 2 control structure derivation is run
no call log entry has step <retired_step>

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-13 control structure is written to control-structure.yaml

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for all four Stage 2 calls
a run directory for output
Stage 2 control structure derivation is run
a file control-structure.yaml exists in the run directory
the file contains a valid ControlStructure model when read back

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-14 Call 2a receives requirements from Call 1

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid RequirementSet for Call 1
an LLM that returns a valid ResponsibilitySet for Call 2a
Stage 2 calls 1 through 2a are run in sequence
the Call 2a user prompt contains the requirements from Call 1

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-15 Call 2b receives responsibilities from Call 2a

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for Stage 2 calls 1 and 2a
an LLM that returns a valid ControlElementSet JSON with controlled process CP-1
Stage 2 calls 1 through 2b are run in sequence
the Call 2b user prompt contains the responsibilities from Call 2a

scenarios.name: SP1-S2-16 Call 3 receives the assembled control structure

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for Stage 2 calls 1, 2a, and 2b
an LLM that returns a valid CoordinationAnalysis with coordination link CL-1
Stage 2 calls 1 through 3 are run in sequence
the Call 3 user prompt contains the assembled responsibilities and controlled processes
